entries.title: Isaiah 10:1
segments: ¶"Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, Who write misfortune, [Which] they have prescribed

entries.title: Isaiah 10:2
segments: To rob the needy of justice, And to take what is right from the poor of My people, That widows may be their prey, And [that] they may rob the fatherless.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:3
segments: What will you do in the day of punishment, And in the desolation [which] will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? And where will you leave your glory?

entries.title: Isaiah 10:4
segments: Without Me they shall bow down among the prisoners, And they shall fall among the slain." For all this His anger is not turned away, But His hand [is] stretched out still.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:5
segments: ¶"Woe to Assyria, the rod of My anger And the staff in whose hand is My indignation.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:6
segments: I will send him against an ungodly nation, And against the people of My wrath I will give him charge, To seize the spoil, to take the prey, And to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:7
segments: Yet he does not mean so, Nor does his heart think so; But [it is] in his heart to destroy, And cut off not a few nations.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:8
segments: For he says, '[Are] not my princes altogether kings?

entries.title: Isaiah 10:9
segments: [Is] not Calno like Carchemish? [Is] not Hamath like Arpad? [Is] not Samaria like Damascus?

entries.title: Isaiah 10:10
segments: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, Whose carved images excelled those of Jerusalem and Samaria,

entries.title: Isaiah 10:11
segments: As I have done to Samaria and her idols, Shall I not do also to Jerusalem and her idols?'"

entries.title: Isaiah 10:12
segments: Therefore it shall come to pass, when the Lord has performed all His work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, [that He will say], "I will punish the fruit of the arrogant heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his haughty looks."

entries.title: Isaiah 10:13
segments: For he says: "By the strength of my hand I have done [it], And by my wisdom, for I am prudent; Also I have removed the boundaries of the people, And have robbed their treasuries; So I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant [man].

entries.title: Isaiah 10:14
segments: My hand has found like a nest the riches of the people, And as one gathers eggs [that are] left, I have gathered all the earth; And there was no one who moved [his] wing, Nor opened [his] mouth with even a peep."

entries.title: Isaiah 10:15
segments: Shall the ax boast itself against him who chops with it? [Or] shall the saw exalt itself against him who saws with it? As if a rod could wield [itself] against those who lift it up, [Or] as if a staff could lift up, [as if it were] not wood!

entries.title: Isaiah 10:16
segments: Therefore the Lord, the Lord of hosts, Will send leanness among his fat ones; And under his glory He will kindle a burning Like the burning of a fire.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:17
segments: So the Light of Israel will be for a fire, And his Holy One for a flame; It will burn and devour His thorns and his briers in one day.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:18
segments: And it will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, Both soul and body; And they will be as when a sick man wastes away.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:19
segments: Then the rest of the trees of his forest Will be so few in number That a child may write them.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:20
segments: ¶And it shall come to pass in that day [That] the remnant of Israel, And such as have escaped of the house of Jacob, Will never again depend on him who defeated them, But will depend on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:21
segments: The remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob, To the Mighty God.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:22
segments: For though your people, O Israel, be as the sand of the sea, A remnant of them will return; The destruction decreed shall overflow with righteousness.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:23
segments: For the Lord GOD of hosts Will make a determined end In the midst of all the land.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:24
segments: ¶Therefore thus says the Lord GOD of hosts: "O My people, who dwell in Zion, do not be afraid of the Assyrian. He shall strike you with a rod and lift up his staff against you, in the manner of Egypt.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:25
segments: "For yet a very little while and the indignation will cease, as will My anger in their destruction."

entries.title: Isaiah 10:26
segments: And the LORD of hosts will stir up a scourge for him like the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb; [as] His rod was on the sea, so will He lift it up in the manner of Egypt.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:27
segments: It shall come to pass in that day [That] his burden will be taken away from your shoulder, And his yoke from your neck, And the yoke will be destroyed because of the anointing oil.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:28
segments: He has come to Aiath, He has passed Migron; At Michmash he has attended to his equipment.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:29
segments: They have gone along the ridge, They have taken up lodging at Geba. Ramah is afraid, Gibeah of Saul has fled.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:30
segments: Lift up your voice, O daughter of Gallim! Cause it to be heard as far as Laish-O poor Anathoth!

entries.title: Isaiah 10:31
segments: Madmenah has fled, The inhabitants of Gebim seek refuge.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:32
segments: As yet he will remain at Nob that day; He will shake his fist at the mount of the daughter of Zion, The hill of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:33
segments: Behold, the Lord, The LORD of hosts, Will lop off the bough with terror; Those of high stature [will be] hewn down, And the haughty will be humbled.

entries.title: Isaiah 10:34
segments: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, And Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
